diagnosis.root_cause: DrawDest drained a previous homogeneous StageExtensionTime/GOAL batch on incoming foreign sprite Draw but its FlushTracked call used the already-selected INCOMING GameSemantic scope. That physically submits the previous GPU geometry with wrong ScreenHud/producer identity, unlike FlushDest/EndDest which already rebind the original deferred owner.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Actual source direct and queued six +TIME edges have tags; native D3DX Flush may execute at new Draw texture boundary. Latest 2026-10-16 static execution-order findings #132 corroborate deferred execution as an unverified visual-risk path, not HMD-proof.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Actual D3D9 physical Draw hooks classify and reproject R84 left/right eye only using GPU-time source semantics. The old batch must remain ScreenHud exact source while flushing; R33 and R30 per-eye HMD path are unchanged.
